questions.question_text: Do you have a documented Information Security Policy approved by management?
Is the Information Security Policy reviewed at planned intervals?
Are information security roles and responsibilities defined and allocated?
Are background verification checks conducted on all candidates for employment?
Are employees required to sign confidentiality or NDA agreements?
Is security awareness training provided to all employees?
Is there a formal disciplinary process for information security violations?
Is there a physical perimeter protecting information processing facilities?
Is access to secure areas controlled using multi-factor authentication?
Are equipment and assets protected from physical threats?
Is there an inventory of all information assets maintained?
Are information assets classified according to sensitivity?
Is there a documented procedure for handling and disposing of classified media?
Is there a formal access control policy?
Is there a formal user registration and de-registration process?
Is privileged access managed and regularly reviewed?
Is MFA enforced for all remote access and privileged accounts?
Is a cryptographic policy defined and implemented?
Are encryption keys managed throughout their lifecycle?
Is data in transit encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher?
Is data at rest encrypted?
Are operating procedures documented and made available to users who need them?
Is malware detection and prevention implemented on all systems?
Are information backups taken and tested regularly?
Are event logs recorded, protected, and regularly reviewed?
Is vulnerability management conducted on a regular basis?
Are networks segregated to separate trusted and untrusted zones?
Are information transfer policies documented and implemented?
Are security requirements analyzed and specified for new information systems?
Is secure coding practiced and documented in development?
Are test data protected and controlled?
Are information security requirements agreed with suppliers?
Is supplier compliance with security requirements monitored regularly?
Is there a formal incident management process in place?
Are information security incidents reported in a timely manner?
Is there a business continuity plan that includes information security?
Is the business continuity plan tested at planned intervals?
Are all applicable legal and regulatory requirements identified and documented?
Is compliance with security policies reviewed regularly?
Upload your ISO 27001 certificate or Statement of Applicability.
When was your last internal audit conducted?
When was your last management review conducted?
Describe any open non-conformities from your last audit.
Are you currently certified to ISO 27001?
What is the scope of your ISO 27001 certification?
Who is your certifying body?
When does your current ISO 27001 certificate expire?
Do you have a continuous improvement process for your ISMS?
Is there a dedicated information security team or CISO?
Describe any significant security incidents in the past 12 months.
